rule: These hypotheses may be supported, narrowed, contradicted or marked non-applicable during HD1–HD8, but their definitions must not be edited until HD9 synthesis. New historical structures go to residuals only.

successInvariants.name: Reality / Representation separation
successInvariants.claim: Proxy, model, report, metric, description or prediction must not be silently collapsed into the realized state or consequence that matters.

successInvariants.name: Evaluator integrity and independent verification
successInvariants.claim: Evaluation is part of the world and can fail or be gamed; decisive claims need verification whose failure modes are themselves represented.

successInvariants.name: Generalization beyond optimized signal
successInvariants.claim: Improvement must survive materially different conditions beyond the exact signal, case, seed or environment optimized.

successInvariants.name: Conditional operator/search policy
successInvariants.claim: The useful method depends on current evidence/problem/world conditions; one fixed global method is not assumed optimal.

successInvariants.name: Explicit compact persistent state
successInvariants.claim: Durable useful state should preserve verified causal/provenance/constraint information rather than equal raw accumulated history.

successInvariants.name: Adaptive overhead must repay itself
successInvariants.claim: Additional search, orchestration, control or complexity must produce decision-relevant value beyond a strong simpler baseline sufficient to repay its cost.

successInvariants.name: Metaproductivity
successInvariants.claim: A major improvement can matter because it changes the future production function of discovery/improvement, not merely current performance.

successInvariants.name: Prediction-error world-model update
successInvariants.claim: Predictions should be corrected against realized observations/transitions; model accuracy does not grant authority over reality.

successInvariants.name: Scoped authority / admissibility
successInvariants.claim: Knowledge, selection or technical capability does not automatically grant authority, legitimacy or safe admissibility for consequence-bearing action.

successInvariants.name: Multi-axis domain truth
successInvariants.claim: A single proxy score is often insufficient when distinct causal/value dimensions can diverge.

antiLaws.name: Raw accumulated history or arbitrary lossy compression = sufficient state
One fixed global method/operator is sufficient

higherOrderConvergenceHypothesis: Successful structures should show repeated cross-epoch/cross-domain recurrence at the semantic level. Failed surface mechanisms may be diverse, while causal anti-laws may also recur. Neither recurrence nor historical prestige implies universality.
falsificationExpectation: At least one historical domain/epoch should materially narrow or contradict a frozen invariant; absence of any contradiction after 320 trajectories triggers a confirmation-bias audit before stronger claims are allowed.
